notes.title: Thalamus speed running announcement.
notes.content:
[h1]Thalamus speed running announcement.[/h1]

Hey everyone we would like to announce that we have made a speed running page for those of you who are interested in speed running the game. We have already set up a channel in our discord if you would like to talk to some fellow runners. As of writing this the time to beat is 12:12 by Klania911. We hope everyone has fun while we try to finish chapter 2 (and do a few runs of our own). HAPPY SPEEDRUNNING!

[h1]More Information [/h1]
https://www.speedrun.com/thalamus
[url=https://livesplit.org/]Live Split[/url] is needed and the configuration file can be found in the 'speedrunning' channel in our [url=https://discord.gg/YathE3G2uK]discord server[/url]

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
[h1]Small update(UI Fixes and Map Improvements)[/h1]

-New UI font
-Lab elevator got a little bit more ware.
-Lab stair well lighting fix

[h1]Coming in next updates![/h1]
-plan on making interactable objects more noticeable. While watching people playthrough the game we noticed players spending a lot of time searching.
-Loud audio fix
-Improved voice lines. 
-Possibly rewindable keys

notes.title: Thalamus Bug Update
notes.content: We had a few bugs on launch but most of the issues should be solved by tomorrow. Once again please let us know if you find any fame breaking bugs.

notes.title: Update Thalamus soundtrack (1.2)
notes.content: Hello everyone, this is the Thalamus development team back to tell you all that we have added a new song to the Thalamus soundtrack. As we come closer to the release of the first part of Thalamus we would like to show (or rather let you listen) to a new song by our composer. The song is called “Dreadful Regret” and we hope you like it. Thalamus is coming along nicely, and it looks like we will meet the planned release window (hopefully). Again, we are very active on our discord server if you want to talk to us ( https://discord.gg/YathE3G2uK ). That is all from us, we at the Thalamus development team wish you all a good day :)
